query: SELECT activity.actor_key AS "actor_key!: String", MIN(activity.activity_sequence) AS "first_activity_sequence!: i64" FROM board_activity activity WHERE ((activity.root_id=? AND activity.kind='threadMessageCreated') OR (activity.message_id=? AND activity.kind='mainMessageCreated')) AND activity.message_id IS NOT NULL AND activity.actor_key<>? AND activity.activity_sequence>? GROUP BY activity.actor_key ORDER BY MIN(activity.activity_sequence) ASC
